title: 🔥宏观环境处于风险关闭
body: 市场处于宏观压制期。BMRI指标读数为73，处于RISK_OFF区间，说明当前美元流动性环境不支持风险资产大幅扩张。虽然油价下跌引发降息押注，但该指标显示宏观紧缩实际影响犹在。AHR999仅为0.34的低位信号，需等待流动性拐点确认。中性。降息博弈还能持续吗？
body_en: The market is under macro suppression. The BMRI indicator sits at 73, deep in the RISK_OFF zone, signaling that current USD liquidity conditions can't support a major expansion in risk assets. Even though falling oil prices have sparked rate cut bets, this indicator shows the actual drag of macro tightening is still very real. AHR999 is flashing lows at just 0.34—we need to wait for confirmation of a liquidity inflection point. Neutral. Can the rate cut game last much longer?
